skill.description: Use when the user asks to "draft an influencer contract", "review these agreement terms", or "build a partnership template"; produces a full influencer agreement framework (scope, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, FTC disclosure), a clause-by-clause review with red flags, and a negotiation cheat sheet. Not for outreach negotiation before a deal exists — use outreach-manager.
skill.summary: Drafts and reviews influencer agreements with clause guidance, red flags, and negotiation ranges.

content.value_statement: Influencer partnerships need clear deliverables, payment terms, usage rights, and disclosure language. This skill drafts agreement templates, reviews terms, and highlights negotiation risks.
actual_capabilities: Gathers parties, deliverables, compensation, platform, usage rights, exclusivity, and approval details.
Drafts an influencer partnership agreement with eleven standard sections.
Reviews incoming contract terms against an essential-terms and red-flag checklist.
Explains key clauses including deliverables, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, approval, and morality clauses.
Creates negotiation ranges for rights duration, exclusivity, revisions, payment timing, and whitelisting.
limitations: Provides general contract guidance, not legal advice.
Requires user-provided deal details or pasted contract terms.
Does not execute e-signature routing or update external systems by itself.
Templates may need adaptation for local law, industry rules, and platform policies.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Creator Agreement
use_cases.description: Turn agreed deal terms into a structured influencer agreement with deliverables, payment, rights, approvals, and disclosure requirements.

use_cases.title: Review Agency Paper
use_cases.description: Check incoming contract terms for missing essentials, one-sided rights, broad exclusivity, payment risk, and unclear revision rules.

use_cases.title: Build a Reusable Template
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable partnership template that teams can adapt for campaign size, platform, compensation, and usage-rights scope.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Agreement
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with known deliverables and compensation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a simple influencer agreement for [creator name] to create [deliverables] on [platform] for [compensation]. Include payment timing, usage rights, approval steps, and FTC disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Review Incoming Terms
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of pasted agency or brand language.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these influencer contract terms for missing essentials, red flags, and negotiation points. Focus on usage rights, exclusivity, payment, revisions, termination, and disclosure: [paste terms].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Negotiation Sheet
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation before sending proposed edits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a negotiation cheat sheet for this creator deal: [deal summary]. Show each open term, the current position, standard range, recommended counter, and fallback position.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced template creation for repeated partnership work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a reusable influencer agreement template for [campaign type] across [platforms]. Include placeholders, clause notes, optional sections, and guidance for small, mid-size, and enterprise deals.

output_examples.input: Draft a micro-influencer agreement for two Instagram posts for $500.
output_examples.output: A streamlined agreement with parties, two Instagram deliverables, $500 payment terms, a short approval timeline, non-exclusive owned-channel usage, FTC disclosure, and signature blocks.

output_examples.input: Review an agency contract that asks for perpetual paid usage and six months of category exclusivity.
output_examples.output: A review memo that flags perpetual usage, unpaid whitelisting, broad exclusivity, and unclear payment timing, with practical counteroffers for each term.

output_examples.input: Create a template for recurring TikTok creator campaigns.
output_examples.output: A reusable agreement framework with platform-specific deliverables, review windows, Spark Ads options, disclosure language, compensation schedules, and optional exclusivity sections.

best_practices: Provide exact deliverables, platforms, compensation, dates, and usage-rights scope before drafting.
Mark unknown terms as TBD and send the final agreement to qualified legal counsel.
Limit usage rights, exclusivity, whitelisting, and revisions to terms that match the deal value.
anti_patterns: Do not use the template as final legal advice without attorney review.
Do not leave payment timing, approval deadlines, or usage-rights duration vague.
Do not accept broad exclusivity or perpetual paid usage without separate compensation.

faq.question: Is this a substitute for a lawyer?
faq.answer: No. It provides general templates and review guidance. A qualified lawyer should review agreements before signature.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide parties, deliverables, platforms, dates, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, approval process, and any required disclosure language.

faq.question: Can it review a contract from an agency?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the terms and ask for missing essentials, red flags, and negotiation points.

faq.question: Does it handle FTC disclosure language?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sponsorship disclosure prompts and reminds users to follow applicable FTC and platform rules.

faq.question: Can it make a short contract for small deals?
faq.answer: Yes. It can scale down heavier sections when the scope and value are small.

faq.question: Does it send contracts for signature?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare agreement text and note optional e-signature routing, but it does not send documents by itself.
